verdict.rationale: The only founder-facing explanatory content on the firm's own pages is the Lowenstein x Clerky page and its FAQ. That page describes formation steps (Delaware C-corp setup, bylaws, founder stock issuance, 83(b) elections, vesting capture), but it reads as a product and pricing FAQ rather than an educational knowledge base. The remaining pages are practice-area service descriptions, not plain-language guides. Missing for 10: a dedicated startup resource library or knowledge base, plain-language explainers on financing (SAFEs, priced rounds) and equity/cap tables, educational formation guides beyond the Clerky product FAQ, and any independent corroboration.
